scope: Full-depth fixed-strength LoopCD-Hidden on Huginn R16 and R32 across the four existing multiple-choice tasks.
primary_mean: Equal weight for each of four fixed task accuracies, computed separately at each depth.

bootstrap.method: Paired question resampling independently within fixed tasks; percentile 95% interval

permutation.method: Two-sided correctness sign flips within tasks; equal-task mean and plus-one Monte Carlo p

multiplicity.method: Separate Holm families: 2 depths x 4 tasks x 2 contrasts, and 2 depths x 2 mean contrasts

timing.description: Independent baseline, fixed Logits and Hidden policies on identical candidate batches and initial states; fixed length-quantile selection; geometric mean latency ratios across four tasks at each depth.

parameter_selection: Paper Table 3(a)/A4 multiple-choice settings fixed before Hidden scoring; no task-specific tuning. All original Logits and baseline outcomes were already known.
